# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.1

A firmware hotfix for 0.4.0: display commands are paced, so the Nextion's
serial receive buffer no longer overflows.

## Before updating

- Flash the updated ESPHome firmware; the pacing runs in the firmware.

## Fixed

- **Prevent Nextion serial RX buffer overflows** — every firmware display
  command is paced with ESPHome's Nextion command pacer, and Clock Two queues
  its complete word matrix as one render batch. The release also includes the
  previously fixed Clock Two font-size and background issues.
